note: PLACEHOLDER interest slots. NOT open for enrolment. Parents can only say they are interested; the owner decides which to open. Edit this file and rebuild (python3 lp_build.py && python3 level_pages.py && python3 build_site.py) to add, remove or retime a placeholder. R1-R4 come from docs/schedule/beta_reserved.json; the Monday slots are afternoons/evenings the owner's calendar is free (1:15pm to 9pm). Fields: id (letters, digits, hyphen, max 16; stored with each request, so do not reuse an id for a different time), label, sessions [{day,start,end}], levels (which level cards show it), window (true = a time window, the parent's class would start inside it, with a second weekday to agree), show (false hides it without deleting).
